finding: Mechanism 2 (defect log) shipped unbounded — no schema, no location, no gate. Fixed by binding to defects.jsonl with 'none' sentinel and a greppable absence gate. The defect-log mechanism is itself UNVERIFIED until a real task produces one; this file is the first exerciser of the binding, written under it.
why_not_fixed: n/a — the finding IS the fix

finding: The audit brief claimed the harness tab was 'a feature the process couldn't deliver' — an unbound causal claim. The process postdates the tab; removal and process are coincident, not causal. Downgraded to 'removed during the same exercise; the process did not surface it.'

The §0 nine-lies framing lumped plain environment defects (shared worktree, post-fix pin) with surfaces that report false success. Corrected the category: environment-lying-to-a-measurement vs artifact-level unfalsifiable compliance — family, not one category.

The value-unit adversarial gate had no binding — unspecified what the reviewer receives or where the verdict lands. Fixed: reviewer gets spec+diff only, verdict recorded as ADVERSARIAL REVIEW PASSED/FAILED, gate fails closed.
The loop had no exit rule. Added step 7: round budget + termination condition declared before review begins, so a process that can't terminate stops eating the schedule.

marker derivation survived the fixture (6/6) but degraded on real sessions: subject-symbol extraction returned stopwords ('the','all') for 2 of 7 subject-symbol candidates, and the cross-check (absent-at-pin + present-in-completion) nulled those markers — the honest fallback worked, but selection v0.1 emits only 1 test-backed candidate with a derived marker; the rest are N=2 (human-authored description+marker). Selection-bias gradient confirmed at this layer too: derivation is strongest where the task was cleanest.
why_not_fixed: Subject-symbol extraction needs a stopword filter + better identifier detection; the cross-check nulling is CORRECT behavior (honest fallback), but extraction quality is the bottleneck and not fixed this pass. Test-path availability (10/42) is lower than hoped because 'session ran tests' != 'test discriminates this task'.

finding: decision log records rejections + first_user_msg, but does NOT record per-marker null-reason (extraction-fail vs cross-check-fail) — the auditable gap persists one level down.
why_not_fixed: selection.py logs gate outcomes but not the fine-grained marker-why; would need a marker_reason field per draft. Small, deferred.

finding: First end-to-end yield: 8 drafts emitted -> 2 reviewable (25%). Dropped: 3 cron-junk (source=telegram but trajectory=cron content — 14th instance of summary-vs-trajectory, screen filtered by source column not content), 1 mislabeled assertion (tests vs subject_symbol), 2 entangled strftime pair (163851 find + 164758 replace = one refactor, both pin fb05b55; #4's natural marker _fmt_ts is pre-existing at that pin via unrelated commit 99ea544a, so it fails the precondition gate regardless). This is the pipeline's real usable-output rate, well below the 42/29% screen implied.
why_not_fixed: Selection needs (a) trajectory-content cron filter (screen on content not source column), (b) budget upper cap (pathological 59hr duration produced 215k s budget), (c) entanglement detection for same-pin sequential sessions. Cron filter + budget cap are next-pass fixes; entanglement may be a selection-time pair detection.

finding: 15th failure, NEW family: the gate auditing the wrong subject. containment_check passed the candidate id (222458) not the replay session id; candidate's own tool calls reference the real repo, so every replay false-flagged. Right method, right data, wrong entity. Provenance bugs: every value correct, the binding between them wrong. Fixed at the right layer (adapter returns session_id from stderr; runner audits replay_sid, candidate id is fallback only).
why_not_fixed: n/a — fixed. Replay session id now bound in run record as replay_session_id. Distinguishing test: test_containment_identity.py (replay passes, candidate audited alone would flag).

finding: All k=3 verdicts from the first clean-batch run are INVALID (containment false-positives from the identity bug). Agents did work in worktrees; the gate flagged the wrong session. Discarded, not reported.
why_not_fixed: n/a — verdicts invalidated by the provenance fix; batch re-run under corrected containment.
